headline: Nigerian Naira Slumps to 1,344 Per Dollar in Official Market
summary: Nigeria's naira posted its sharpest weekly decline as the US dollar climbed to N1,344.40 in the official foreign exchange market, alongside mounting parallel-market pressure.
why: Persistent naira depreciation increases import costs, fuels domestic inflation, and complicates hard-currency repatriation for multinational corporations.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Official currency devaluation raises debt servicing costs on dollar debt and drives up domestic food and fuel prices.
